build_ByteProxyMapping: build a ByteProxyMapping instance from a HuggingFace tokenizer to map bytes to proxy characters
encode_byte2proxychar_cdp: encode a single byte value to its proxy character code point using ByteProxyMapping
decode_proxytoken2bytes: decode a proxy token string back into its original bytes sequence
build_LLAMAByteProxyMapper: build a LLAMAByteProxyMapper to decode LLaMA hex tokens and BPE tokens to bytes
token2bytes: convert a proxy token string directly to bytes using the tokenizer byte decoder
